jobs.detail: LEVER SEATED REVERSE FLY, OVERHAND PRONATED GRIP. REAR three-quarter camera, adult sits facing machine with CHEST against front upright pad, feet flat floor, torso upright stationary. Both hands grip HORIZONTAL handles palms DOWN, thumbs securely wrapped, not vertical neutral grips. LEFT start both upper arms reach FORWARD around chest pad at shoulder level, elbows NEARLY STRAIGHT just15degrees flexion, hands FAR in FRONT of chest, no90degree bent elbows, no rowing. RIGHT spread upper arms OUTWARD/BACK in wide shoulder arcs to sides at shoulder level, SAME15degree elbow bend, shoulder blades retract. Stop upper arms in plane of torso, no excessive extension behind back. No torso rotation, shrug or elbow extension/flexion. Simple machine has two independent rigid levers SAME length rotating around two FIXED VERTICAL axes above/front respective shoulders; both handles always visibly connected to their own steel lever. Fixed frame, pad, seat, weight stack, base remain IDENTICAL across phases. Red exposed POSTERIOR DELTOIDS ONLY on both shoulder caps, back/traps/triceps/forearms grayscale. Entire black shirt/shorts BLACK with no red fabric. Full wide-open arms/handles and machine comfortably inside each panel.
jobs.prompt: Correct LEFT START PANEL ONLY in this original project overhand reverse-fly illustration. Both arms must reach FORWARD toward the machine's chest pad with hands close together directly IN FRONT of chest pad, not spread out to sides. Keep both elbows nearly straight/soft15degrees. Rotate BOTH upper arms forward at shoulders, foreshorten arms as appropriate to rear-three-quarter view; hands should be approximately shoulder width apart in front, not at opposite panel edges. Both hands wrap HORIZONTAL handgrips with palms DOWN in overhand/pronated grip, thumbs opposing fingers; never vertical neutral grips. Move connected machine levers into forward/closed starting position to meet hands, retaining fixed pivots, identical lever lengths and continuous steel connections. RIGHT endpoint remains unchanged, arms open laterally at shoulder level. Same seated model, chest against pad, feet planted, torso still, red posterior deltoids only, detailed grayscale exposed anatomy, continuous opaque black shirt and shorts wrapping seat/crotch/front/sides/back. Whole machine and body within panels. No text.
jobs.inspectionNote: Start correction moves both handles forward together, but bends elbows too much and changes lever geometry. Endpoint remains open. Original and correction retained with full opaque clothing and posterior deltoid highlights; reverse-fly technique and overhand grip remain blocked for correction.

poses.caption: Sit supported with straight arms and overhand side handles, shoulders relaxed
Raise both shoulders toward ears while keeping elbows straight and head still

jobs.detail: LEVER SHRUG performed SEATED exactly as canonical instructions. FRONT three-quarter view; back/pelvis supported against upright backrest, feet flat floor. Hands hold two HORIZONTAL side handles just outside hips with OVERHAND PRONATED grip, thumbs around bars; arms hang STRAIGHT and stay straight through both phases, elbows never curl. Handles connected to two simple rigid load levers with fixed pivots on frame and weight-stack resistance. LEFT shoulders relaxed/depressed away from ears, neck long, head neutral. RIGHT elevate BOTH shoulders STRAIGHT UP toward ears, visibly shortened ear-to-shoulder distance, head stays SAME height/neutral, no neck tilt, no shoulder rolling, no elbow bending, no torso rise/lean. Arms move upward because shoulders rise; handles and connected levers rise a SMALL distance with shoulders, same lever lengths and fixed pivots, stack lifts slightly. Same seat/backrest/feet/body/frame between poses. Primary UPPER TRAPEZIUS ONLY exposed RED on neck-to-shoulder slope BOTH sides. Shirt collar narrow enough to show upper traps but shirt fully covers torso front/sides/back, no exposed chest/abs, black garments intact. Deltoids/arms/forearms grayscale. Whole machine/handles/shoes within margins.
